user.title: Create a virtual device
user.description: Name the machine, location, or item whose history you want to keep. Choose a physical device to supply its readings and optional on/off controls. The source stays paired to its existing integration.

readings.title: Choose readings and optional controls
readings.description: Sensors and binary sensors are selected by default. On/off switches are optional. Select a switch to let this virtual device control the mapped physical switch after final confirmation.

behaviour.title: Choose handling for new readings
behaviour.description: Defaults follow Home Assistant state classes. Mirror copies the source value, including a raw counter lifetime value. Allocate counter increases keeps a separate consumption total for this virtual device. Signed changes are for net counters that can go up and down. Existing reading types and units stay fixed. Switches mirror their state and forward on/off commands.

init.title: Manage virtual devices
init.description: All assignment and mapping changes require a review and confirmation.

create.title: Create a virtual device
create.description: Choose its name and first physical source. A review and confirmation are required before anything is created.

readings.title: Choose readings and optional controls
readings.description: Sensors and binary sensors are selected by default. On/off switches are optional. Select a switch to let this virtual device control the mapped physical switch after final confirmation.

behaviour.title: Choose handling for new readings
behaviour.description: Defaults follow Home Assistant state classes. Mirror copies the source value, including a raw counter lifetime value. Allocate counter increases keeps a separate consumption total for this virtual device. Signed changes are for net counters that can go up and down. Existing reading types and units stay fixed. Switches mirror their state and forward on/off commands.

target.title: Choose a virtual device
target.description: Its device identity, existing entity IDs, history, and totals will be kept.

device.title: Choose the physical source
device.description: You can reuse a known device or choose a different one. The current assignment stays active until you finish the mapping review and confirm.

mapping.title: Review the source mapping
mapping.description: Map readings for **{target}** from **{source}**. Saved mappings are reused when compatible. A new match is proposed only when it is unambiguous. Unmapped readings keep their history and become unavailable; allocated counter totals remain visible. Every assignment requires the final confirmation. Switch mappings also route on/off commands to the selected physical device.

extras.title: Additional readings and optional controls
extras.description: These source entities are not used by the mapping. Select any to add to the virtual device. Selecting an on/off switch enables control of that physical switch after final confirmation. Leave extras unselected to ignore them. Existing readings and histories are kept.

data.confirm: I have reviewed the mapping. Apply this change.

name.title: Rename the virtual device
name.description: Entity IDs, mappings, assignments, and recorded history are kept.
